arbitrary_width_bitvector.meaning: BitVec width with explicit modular operations, signed/unsigned decoding and zero-divisor conventions; widths quantified rather than sampled.

binary_float_bits.meaning: Actual admitted format operations observed through stored bits, including zero sign and exceptional encodings; flags are a separate observation.

bit_encoding.meaning: Explicit scalar/lane bitstream encoding, endian order, widths and padding bits.

bounded_dynamic_index.meaning: Actual signed/unsigned finite-word index decoder, integer clamp, bounded result map and representability conditions.

bounded_gather.meaning: An independently defined Gather dimension map, index vector convention, batching, clamping and empty/out-of-bounds behavior.

bounded_index.meaning: Arbitrary finite static ranks/extents, legal bounded coordinate maps, derived transformed shapes and attributes, including zero extents.

bounded_runtime_id.meaning: A finite participant/partition ID model with explicit range and finite-width representation.

complex_pair_bits.meaning: Complex values as explicit pairs of component encodings with declared construction/conversion and projection semantics.

dynamic_shape.meaning: Values paired with bounded runtime extents and static capacities, with explicit dynamic-size observations.

effect_graph.meaning: A typed graph with declared execution/control/state/error observations; pure node equality alone is insufficient.

exact_complex.meaning: Mathematical complex algebra with explicit totalization/domain conditions; not rounded complex execution.

exact_contraction.meaning: A finite contraction with explicit axis maps, scalar semiring product/sum, initializer and tuple/result shape.

exact_field.meaning: An independently admitted mathematical field operation with explicit nonzero or totalized reciprocal domains.

exact_integer.meaning: Unbounded mathematical integers; no implicit transfer to machine arithmetic.

exact_real.meaning: Mathematical real operations with explicit analytic domains and zero/partial-operation conventions.

exact_ring.meaning: Mathematical ring operations and stated scalar identities; no implicit transfer to IEEE arithmetic.

linear_order.meaning: An explicitly specified linear order and actual min/max/clamp/comparison definitions.

linear_ordered_ring.meaning: An exact ordered ring with explicitly defined absolute value and scalar arithmetic.

literal_values.meaning: Typed mathematical tuple/tensor literal values and their actual encoding/pattern predicates.

ordered_float_contraction.meaning: An actual admitted rounded product/conversion/initializer/fold sequence or explicitly specified permitted-result refinement relation.

ordered_reduction.meaning: An explicit whole-state reducer, actual initializer/padding and ordered finite contribution sequence.

ordered_scatter.meaning: A specified indexed update trace with reducer parameter roles, duplicate ordering, batching and out-of-bounds behavior.

ordered_sort.meaning: A specified axis sorting relation/algorithm, comparator calls, stability, tuple coupling and empty-axis behavior.

physical_layout.meaning: Explicit logical-to-storage byte/bit maps, tiles, memory spaces and any observed allocation/transfer/alias effects.

predicate.meaning: Actual Boolean values, Boolean comparisons and legal scalar/tensor predicate shape maps.

principal_complex.meaning: Mathematical principal complex log/power/sqrt with explicit argument/branch-cut and zero domains.

pure_branch.meaning: Typed branch functions and arguments with explicit selector mapping; execution effects need a different profile.

pure_graph.meaning: A mathematical pure typed expression/DAG and its admitted observations; no compiled implementation correspondence.

pure_nary_map.meaning: An actual finite-arity scalar operation and bounded parameter/operand selection, lifted pointwise to explicit shapes.

pure_tensor.meaning: A function from bounded coordinates to declared scalar/tuple values, with explicit static shape.

pure_tuple.meaning: Typed finite products/heterogeneous tuples with bounded projection and component shape/value observations.

random_distribution.meaning: An independently specified probability distribution/joint sampling relation, not assumed seeded-stream equality.

rounded_transcendental.meaning: A concrete rounded exp/log/pow/sqrt/rsqrt/etc. operation and format/exception observations; exact analysis is not its definition.

scalar_conversion.meaning: Explicit source/destination formats, signedness, rounding/saturation, exceptional values and out-of-range behavior.

signed_word_order.meaning: Actual finite-word signed decoding and comparisons, including minimum and maximum values.

stateful_rng.meaning: A specified generator state transition, sample-stream consumption and result coordinate map.

truncating_integer.meaning: Signed integer quotient/remainder truncating toward zero with explicit zero/overflow domains.

unsigned_word_order.meaning: Actual unsigned finite-word value order and comparison semantics.
